INSTRUCTIONS TO APPLICANTS:
1. Candidate must submit the Appellate Medical Board Certificates SADAREM / UDID
card, Xerox copy of the relevant Academic Education qualification and Technical
education qualification (if necessary) , Bonofide/ Study Certificate from 1st to 7th class,
and proof of the date of birth should be enclosed mandatory.
2. The Candidate should submit his / her native residential certificate issued by the
Mandal Tahsildar concerned for those who are not studied in any educational
instructions.
3. The candidate should apply separately for each post by enclosing all the documents
duly attested by Gazetted Officer mandatory.
4. Candidate should submit nativity certificate of the parents for those who are studied in
special schools (VH/HH).
5. The candidates who are having 40% of degree of percentage of bench mark disability
are eligible to apply these posts except hearing impaired candidates who should have
75% of degree of bench mark Disability as per rules in force
6. All the post reserved for local candidates.
7. The candidates who are serving in any Government Department should apply through
proper channel ( from employer)
8. All the candidates should handover the applications personally (or) through the
Authorized Person but not either Registered post or any mode of communication
within the stipulated time.
9. Last date for submission of application is ____ / ____ / ________ Time: _________PM.
10. The candidate having temporary Disability Certificate are not eligible as per rules.
11. Both Male and Female can apply if the post is reserved in that particular Disabled
Category.

I hereby declare that the particulars furnished in this application and the

verification. If any information furnished by me is found to be false or any forged
documents are submitted, I shall be responsible for the action taken against me as per the
applicable rules.
